ranked.headline: Interactive tools package omics meta-analysis, feature selection and enrichment workflows
ranked.summary: Omics studies increasingly need reproducible, code-free access to ranked-feature meta-analysis, enrichment and multi-omics integration.

ranked.headline: Single-cell and spatial omics models probed for specific failure modes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints target named failure modes in single-cell and spatial omics models, from background confounding to outlier, batch, and linear-redundancy…

ranked.headline: Single-cell computational methods infer regulators, trajectories and tumor lineages
ranked.summary: Longitudinal, multimodal and lineage-barcoded single-cell datasets are now paired with inference methods that model dynamics and regulation directly.

ranked.headline: Minimal and spatial models link cell-scale rules to population-level outcomes
ranked.summary: Reduced and spatially resolved models now connect individual cell behavior, lesion patterns, and hypoxic growth switching to population-level outcomes.

ranked.headline: Pretrained RNA language model embeddings paired with graph and state-space architectures
ranked.summary: Preprints and publications now pair pretrained RNA and protein language model embeddings with graph, Mamba, and proximal-context architectures.

ranked.headline: Experimental and computational tools are refining RNA secondary and 3D structure models
ranked.summary: Refined tRNA Structure-seq data and FRET-guided model selection now sharpen how RNA structure predictions are checked against experimental readouts.

ranked.headline: Open tools for selection, admixture, and ancestry inference from genomic data
ranked.summary: Recent tools automate selection scans, admixture and ancestry estimation, and low-coverage simulation over large genomic datasets.

ranked.headline: Fusing structure, sequence and embedding inputs for TCR, BCR and MHC-peptide binding
ranked.summary: Recent reports pair predicted structures, pretrained embeddings and generative augmentation with graph networks for immune-recognition prediction.

ranked.headline: Supervised models on omics data gain generalizability via representation and bias control
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and published studies pair foundation-model embeddings, feature screening, and bias correction with molecular classifiers.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking sequencing tools for transcript and transposable element quantification
ranked.summary: Benchmarks and automated pipelines test how reliably sequencing-based tools quantify transcripts, transposable elements, and RNA-protein interactions.

ranked.headline: Histology and transcriptomics fused to reconstruct multiscale tissue architecture
ranked.summary: Imaging and spatial transcriptomics are being coupled in computational frameworks that infer tissue structure from histology, scRNA-seq, and cell painting.

ranked.headline: Synaptic tuning, sign constraints and conductance shape coding limits and network dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints treat synaptic tuning, sign constraints, and conductance as direct limits on population coding efficiency and dynamics.

ranked.headline: Spatial and genetic dependence now inform pathogen transmission inference
ranked.summary: February 2026 preprints encode host mobility, spatio-temporal priors, and viral haplotype similarity into transmission inference models.

ranked.headline: Learned surrogates predict mechanical fields and link them to spatial biology
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair learned surrogates with spatially resolved mechanical measurements, linking predicted stress fields to tissue-scale biology.

ranked.headline: Learned models extend genetic association testing to imaging and disease progression
ranked.summary: Deep and multivariate models are now coupled to association testing, shifting them from prediction toward locus-level inference.

ranked.headline: Computational design and scoring of biological sequences checked against experiment
ranked.summary: Learned and rule-based models now generate sequences and variants that are tested against yeast import assays and rumen flux analysis.

ranked.headline: Deep learning links peptide sequence and structure to antimicrobial function
ranked.summary: Protein language model embeddings and structure-aware architectures now target generation and interaction-level prediction, not only sequence classification.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks and audits are testing ML models across molecular and microbiome data
ranked.summary: Standardized public benchmarks, simulators and leaderboard audits address reproducibility and data leakage in ML models for biological data.

ranked.headline: Faster and more portable tools for core sequencing read, alignment and annotation tasks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair performance gains with Rust, SIMD and multithreaded reimplementation of long-read, amplicon and metatranscriptomic workflows.

ranked.headline: AI structure models tested against experimental data and mutational constraints
ranked.summary: Structure and binding predictors are now assessed against experimental ensembles, measured affinities, and deep mutational scans.

ranked.headline: Graph and partition methods for single-cell and spatial multi-omic data analysis
ranked.summary: Graph-based methods now integrate paired single-cell multi-omics and score spatial transcriptomic clustering quality, alongside a new spatial co-occurrence…

ranked.headline: Autonomous LLM agents are automating single-cell and multi-domain biological discovery
ranked.summary: LLM agents and foundation models are being benchmarked and built into autonomous workflows for single-cell, microbiome, and lipid-design discovery.

ranked.headline: Long-read and methylation-resolved methods link sequence context to epigenomic state
ranked.summary: Long-read sequencing now resolves single-nucleotide methylation and somatic variation, with new pipelines making these analyses scalable and robust.

ranked.headline: Splicing benchmarks, dual-coding exons and nonsense constraint refine RNA regulation
ranked.summary: Benchmarks of splicing models and genome-wide exon studies now test how well sequence and RBP features explain splicing outcomes.

ranked.headline: Learned predictors and virtual screens prioritize ligands for prospective validation
ranked.summary: Generative and predictive models now propose receptor and PPI ligands that are tested experimentally, linking in silico scores to measured activity.

ranked.headline: Mechanical models link tissue forces to rheology, cell cycle and wound closure
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply active foam, vertex and data-driven cell-based models to confluent tissue forces, rheology and wound closure.

ranked.headline: Learned models for peptide sequencing, molecule generation, and MD surrogacy
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair generative and neural-ODE architectures with mass, pharmacokinetic, and MD-trajectory targets.

ranked.headline: Interaction networks paired with system-scale readouts in microbiome-drug modeling
ranked.summary: Recent items pair interaction-level network structure with predicted system-scale outcomes across microbiome and drug-repurposing contexts.

ranked.headline: Tumor-relative spatial expression patterns are mapped without cell segmentation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a 2026 publication apply computational spatial and transcriptomic tests to tumor heterogeneity and patient-linked outcomes.

ranked.headline: Joint and topological model inference for longitudinal and spatio-temporal biomedical data
ranked.summary: Recent bioinformatics work pairs longitudinal biomarker data with joint survival and topological model-selection methods.

ranked.headline: Stochastic reaction-network models fitted and used to guide expression-system design
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs stochastic reaction-network models with parameter fitting, sensitivity analysis, and sequential experiment design.

ranked.headline: Fluorescence readouts constrained by structural models and molecular simulations
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study couple fluorescence observables with structural modeling, dye property prediction, and receptor oligomerization analysis.

ranked.headline: Comparative genomics links protein complex, secretome, and prokaryotic genome evolution
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published archaeal survey apply orthology, structural, and pangenome comparisons across eukaryotes, fungi, and prokaryotes.

ranked.headline: Coarse-grained and geometric methods map binding and folding free energy landscapes
ranked.summary: Coarse-grained and geometric methods are being benchmarked for binding and folding free energies of ligands, DNA, and protein-DNA complexes.

ranked.headline: Acquisition-aware repositories and benchmarks reshape computational proteomics workflows
ranked.summary: Expanding public top-down spectral resources and systematic DIA benchmarking now let proteomics tools be assessed against acquisition mode and platform.

ranked.headline: Network inference from omics data resolves signaling rewiring in cancer cells
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply condition-comparative network models to transcriptomic, phosphoproteomic, proteomic and single-cell data.

ranked.headline: Pangenome graphs resolve structural and TE variation linked to traits and environment
ranked.summary: Graph pangenomes now reach beyond single references to link structural variants with traits, climate adaptation, and organellar-origin insertions.

ranked.headline: Predictive models refine chromatin architecture, cohesin binding, and nucleosome dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs sequence-aware deep learning and reprocessed cohesin ChIP-seq with simulation-based kinetic analysis of nucleosome allostery.

ranked.headline: Assessing conformational ensembles and dynamics of flexible and disordered proteins
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published tool test how well ensemble, network, and dimensionality methods capture protein conformational variability.

ranked.headline: Reaction-network models guide tuning of CRISPRa, riboswitch, and cell-free expression
ranked.summary: Mechanistic and Bayesian design frameworks now address resource competition and expression context in engineered genetic parts.
